hints.title: Full Cycle Duration
hints.text: The pillow travels from person 1 to person n and then back to person 1, taking 2 * (n - 1) seconds for one complete oscillation.

hints.title: Cycle Remainder Computation
hints.text: Find time modulo 2 * (n - 1) to determine the offset within the current back-and-forth round.

hints.title: Direction Branching
hints.text: If remainder is less than n - 1, the pillow moves forward to index 1 + remainder; otherwise, it moves backward.

hints.title: Modular Bouncing Position Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating second-by-second transfers takes O(time) steps.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Uses modular arithmetic on the 2*(n-1) bounce period.
